fields.label: Company
fields.description: Company that owns this project snapshot and controls currency/accounting context.

fields.label: Project
fields.description: ERPNext Project being summarized in this financial snapshot.

fields.label: Snapshot Date
fields.description: Date used to calculate and present the project financial position.

fields.label: Snapshot Title
fields.description: Short title shown to management for this snapshot.

fields.label: Status
fields.description: Review status of this financial snapshot.

fields.label: BOQ Total Amount
fields.description: Total planned project value from approved BOQ lines and generated Work Items.

fields.label: BOQ Material Amount
fields.description: Planned BOQ value for material-category items.

fields.label: BOQ Labor Amount
fields.description: Planned BOQ value for labor-category items.

fields.label: BOQ Equipment Amount
fields.description: Planned BOQ value for equipment-category items.

fields.label: BOQ Subcontract Amount
fields.description: Planned BOQ value for subcontract-category items.

fields.label: BOQ Overhead Amount
fields.description: Planned BOQ value for overhead and site management items.

fields.label: Requested Amount
fields.description: Total value requested through Material Requests linked to project Work Items.

fields.label: Committed Amount
fields.description: Total value committed through Purchase Orders linked to project Work Items.

fields.label: Received Amount
fields.description: Total value received through Purchase Receipts linked to project Work Items.

fields.label: Procurement Invoiced Amount
fields.description: Total supplier invoice value linked to project Work Items.

fields.label: Consumed Amount
fields.description: Total value of materials consumed or issued to site for this project.

fields.label: Procurement Progress Percent
fields.description: Procurement progress percentage compared with the planned BOQ value.

fields.label: Measured Amount
fields.description: Total field-measured value from verified Measurement Entries.

fields.label: Measured Progress Percent
fields.description: Measured progress percentage compared with the planned BOQ value.

fields.label: Measurement Progress Percent
fields.description: Overall measurement progress percentage used for executive tracking.

fields.label: Certified Gross Amount
fields.description: Gross value certified through IPCs before retention and deductions.

fields.label: Certified Net Amount
fields.description: Net payable value certified through IPCs after retention and deductions.

fields.label: Retention Held Amount
fields.description: Total retention amount held from contractor IPCs.

fields.label: Retention Released Amount
fields.description: Total retention amount released back to contractors.

fields.label: Contractor Outstanding Amount
fields.description: Current outstanding contractor exposure from Contractor Accounts.

fields.label: Contractor Paid Amount
fields.description: Total contractor payment amount reflected in contractor control records.

fields.label: Certification Progress Percent
fields.description: IPC certification progress percentage compared with the planned BOQ value.

fields.label: Budget vs Committed Variance
fields.description: Difference between planned BOQ value and committed purchase value.

fields.label: Budget vs Invoiced Variance
fields.description: Difference between planned BOQ value and procurement invoice value.

fields.label: Budget vs Certified Variance
fields.description: Difference between planned BOQ value and certified IPC value.

fields.label: Consumed vs Measured Variance
fields.description: Difference between consumed site cost and measured field value.

fields.label: Cost Risk Status
fields.description: Cost risk level calculated from budget, commitment, invoice, measurement, and certification indicators.

fields.label: Cash Risk Status
fields.description: Cash risk level based on expected inflows, outflows, and upcoming obligations.

fields.label: Overall Status
fields.description: Overall executive status combining cost, cash, progress, and EVM indicators.

fields.label: Executive Summary
fields.description: Management summary explaining the current project financial position.

fields.label: Key Risks
fields.description: Main risks that management should review for this project.

fields.label: Recommendations
fields.description: Recommended management actions based on the snapshot indicators.

name: Project Financial Snapshot
description: Point-in-time CFO summary of project budget, commitments, measured value, certification, retention, exposure, and risk.
